body:
Tested locally on a Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra (Android 16), it works as expected.

Using https://github.com/DarkKilauea/godot-hdr-output for tests.

In the Sponza scene, toggling HDR causes an overall reduction in contrast compared to SDR. This means there's a visible difference in dark areas, which does not occur on Windows and macOS with their respective HDR PRs. I have tried various brightness settings on the device (as well as waiting some time for the automatically detected reference luminance to adjust), and changing the tonemapper. None of these have improved things much on this aspect. I'm not sure to which extent we have control over this.
